author: ruixen.ui
name: bottom-drawers
description: This component is a set of bottom-sliding drawers, each triggered by a separate button and containing different content such as a newsletter signup, feedback form, or contact form. The layout keeps the content compact and centered, making it easy for users to focus on the inputs and actions without distractions. By stacking the buttons and organizing the drawers consistently, it provides a clean, user-friendly interface for quick interactions and data collection.
